# Kekborn · Twelve court portraits

<img id="sittings" width="804" style="max-width:100%;height:auto" alt="Twelve framed frog nobles. Read left to right, four per row. The first row shows a scholar, antiquary, knight and artisan. The second starts with the ivory seer. The third ends with the oxblood councillor." src="data:image/avif;base64,">

The same wedge snout, raised eye turrets and pleated throat carry through all twelve sittings. The frames and court offices are legible across the set. Owner approval is still open on the strength of the craquelure, the separation between expressions and the seer hood in 05 and 11.

The plate above wraps the twelve studies into three rows for reading. In the full edition, `contact-sheet.png` places them in one row, 01 at the left and 12 at the right, with all four rails visible.

## Open the master edition

Save the compact edition as `kekborn-edition.zip`. It contains the twelve original JSON layer records, the file manifest and the corrected rendering guide in `records.tar.xz`. The master PNGs exceed the 64,000-byte Markdown allowance. The reader recreates their exact bytes from the pinned layers and checks them against the enclosed records. Run it with Python 3 and Node.js (tested with 22.23.3) to write **kekborn-approval.zip**.

```sh
python3 kekborn-edition.zip
```

The reader downloads the source at commit `9ab5835fd20d740eafc029416b163dce239d55f8` from `identity-md-launches/goal-3401-create-kekborn-portrait-style`. For offline use, add `--source PATH` pointing to the extracted source directory or its GitHub source ZIP. Both routes check the file hashes and yielded the same 115,295,391-byte archive. [Pinned source and layer library](https://github.com/identity-md-launches/goal-3401-create-kekborn-portrait-style/tree/9ab5835fd20d740eafc029416b163dce239d55f8)

| Inside kekborn-approval.zip | Contents |
|---|---|
| `samples/01.png` through `samples/12.png` | Twelve 2048 × 2560 RGBA masters, 64,958,902 bytes together |
| `samples/01.json` through `samples/12.json` | Input, seed, ordered layers and hashes, shield choices and placements, finish count and master PNG hash |
| `contact-sheet.png` | 3248 × 320, twelve 256 × 320 thumbnails with 16-pixel gutters |
| `manifest.json` | SHA-256 for the other 178 files. Its own digest appears below. |
| `style-guide.md`, `template/bust.svg` | Illustrated painting rules, palette, registration grid and paired do/don’t examples |
| `layers/`, `catalog/` | 80 full-canvas RGBA library PNGs and 26 catalog JSON files |
| `bin/`, `src/`, `test/`, `sample-inputs/`, `tools/`, `docs/` | Compositor, heraldry, tests, twelve input fixtures, approval tools and usage |

If a Markdown viewer hides the plate or disables the download, save the original document as <code>kekborn.html</code> and open it in a browser. The image and download are embedded and work offline.

| 03 | Rare · silver | Knight | Slate · hazel | Serene |
| 04 | Epic · gilded gold | Artisan | Peat · olive | Scowl |

| 08 | Rare · silver | Antiquary | Oxblood · umber | Startled |

| 11 | Rare · silver | Seer | Slate · hazel | Serene |

Ivory and oxblood are the two rare skins. Each office appears twice. Look for the scholar’s wire spectacles, the antiquary’s monocle and sealed scroll, the knight’s plate and gauntlet, the artisan’s apron and brushes, the seer’s orb and the council sash. Five backgrounds and three banners appear across the twelve records. The library includes 15 clothing, accessory and prop layers, five pieces of headwear, five regalia layers and 18 shield parts.

## Painting and assembly

Keep the head and shoulders turned three-quarters to the viewer’s left, with a soft upper-left light. Set the heraldic cloth against a dark backdrop. Carry short strokes around the turrets and along the five throat pleats. The unequal eyes, horizontal pupils, tympanum and heavy jowl give Kekborn its own anatomy. A mirrored bust, equal round cartoon eyes or thick human lips break the design. The palette anchors are umber `#32251F`, forest `#253E32`, moss `#657044`, oxblood `#682F38`, ochre `#B48A47`, gold leaf `#C9A45A` and warm bone `#D7C7A3`.

Register every layer to the top-left origin on the 4:5 master. The aperture runs from (144,144) to (1904,2368), upper bounds exclusive. The far and near eyes sit at (680,936) and (1040,912), on a line of slope −1/15. Seat the crown at (969,680), keep the snout at (422,1120), and fit clothing to the shoulder line from (365,1760) to (1575,1712).

The renderer hashes the UTF-8 wallet string followed immediately by the UTF-8 artSeed. Tier, genetics and traits constrain layer choices. The same seed supplies the shield’s tinctures, division, ordinary and charge. Study 05 has a sable tower on a gold cross over gules. The banner carries it at (1500,340), 240 × 288. The lower rail repeats the same shield at (974,2404), 100 × 120. A metal rim separates the tower from its field. One finishing pass applies warm varnish, seeded cracks and an inward shadow from the top and left rails.

## Details for the owner’s decision

- **Surface.** Brush direction reads on the garments and skin. The fine crack network is too faint to judge in the sheet. On flat guide colours away from the frame shadow, it changed the varnished base by at most three levels in any 8-bit channel, and by at most one on umber and warm bone. The finish runs once on every master, but a visible aged surface remains an open art requirement.
- **Expression.** Ten registered overlays provide small lid and mouth accents. Smug, serene and dim grin are difficult to name from the faces alone. Over the same moss bust, the fraction of aperture pixels moving more than 24 levels in any channel ranged from 0.055% for serene to 0.285% for scowl. Study 02 also shifts the pupils.
- **Seer.** Both 05 and 11 leave the crown exposed between two green strips. At master row 680 the visible hood runs from x 619–794 and 1127–1291 over the moss reference. The robe also crosses the throat. The orb reads clearly. The cloth needs a continuous top to read as a hood.

## Verification and provenance

All 51 tests passed. Two fresh-process renders per input matched in both PNG and JSON bytes. All 178 manifest entries were rehashed, and both shield placements in every record matched one shield image digest. The pinned guide’s example failed on `bg.umber`. The edition’s `docs/render.md` uses `background.umber-hall` and `banner.oxblood-standard`. The corrected example rendered successfully. This documentation edit is the sole change to a trunk file. Before the correction, the manifest SHA-256 was `cdd33844835692440843f4605fd2b5a2397911ed673fa7c022ec520e41f94118`.

The foundation results were `portrait-foundation/{style-guide,moss-skin,wood-frame,raster-core}`. The two `kekborn-library-e3` merges supplied the library, renderer and sample inputs. The final `kekborn-e5-1-fit` results were `pipeline-fit`, `shield-legibility` and `gaze-lids`. The three waves landed the sources. The twelve master pairs, sheet and manifest were generated during this revision. Deployment, minting and spend were all zero.
